item.title: It Compiled, But Will It Run? PE Files and .NET Dependency Resolution on Windows
item.description: A successful build proves that the compiler found what it needed at build time. It does not prove that the application will find everything it needs when it runs on another Windows machine. I learned this while working on binary dependency exploration for .NET applications. The objective sounded simple: take every binary we compile and verify that its dependencies can actually be resolved. Then native DLLs, NuGet packages, .NET Framework, modern .
